manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Fiend Hunter must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Fiend Hunter for its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, it exiles Lagrella until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Fiend Hunter's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Fiend Hunter until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Fiend Hunter is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
